_meta.why_no_rollover: A rollover action needs index.lifecycle.rollover_alias, which a date-named index has no way to carry - every index went straight to the ERROR step and the delete phase below was never reached. The daily name IS the rollover here; there is nothing for the action to do.
_meta.why_14d: The box has 74.7 GB of disk and was at 79% before the cleanup, near Elasticsearch's 85% low watermark. Nothing here is an audit trail - logs are for debugging the last few days, and Prometheus keeps 90 days of metrics for anything longer.
_meta.ages_from_the_name: wiser-logs-template.json sets index.lifecycle.parse_origination_date, so min_age counts from the date in the index name rather than from when the index was created. Without it, a backfill - filebeat re-reading old container logs after losing its registry - would keep three-month-old lines for a further fourteen days.
